races.display_title: Ballylinch Stud Irish EBF Ingabelle Stakes (Fillies' Listed)
races.verdict: TIMELESS TALE possibly didn't beat much on her debut at Naas but was still most impressive and, with the performance supported by a strong timefigure, she looks capable of taking the rise in grade in her stride on the way to even better things. Maire Rua is bred to be smart and remains one to be positive about having not been seen to best effect on her first try at listed level at Cork. Ibelieveicanfly is much respected back down in grade, too. TIMELESS TALE (IRE) MAIRE RUA IBELIEVEICANFLY (USA)

races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Sovereign Path Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict: VAFORTINO has shaped better than the bare result in valuable handicaps at Royal Ascot and Galway the last twice, looking unlucky not to win latterly. Well treated on past form, he can end his losing run granted better luck. Gleneagle Bay , also better than the result at Galway, rates the main danger from 3 lb lower, with Collecting Coin and Fort Vega also respected. Any market support for last year’s winner Rahmi would be well worth noting. VAFORTINO (IRE) GLENEAGLE BAY (IRE) COLLECTING COIN

races.display_title: World Pool Bet With Tote Autumn Fillies Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict: As anticipated for the prize money on offer this looks fiendishly competitive. Preference is for THRIFTY OF DIGBY , who has run her race more often than not this year, and Jessica Harrington's mare couldn't have gone much closer to adding to her tally here last time. Suzie Songs heads up the dangers arriving on a hat-trick for her handicap debut, with Rebel Wave , Bella Colombia and Aviatrice just a handful of others worth considering, too. THRIFTY OF DIGBY (IRE) SUZIE SONGS (IRE) REBEL WAVE (IRE)

races.verdict: DESERT CASTLE created a most favourable impression when making an impressive winning start to his career at Newmarket last month and, open to oodles of improvement, he's fancied to overcome the rise in grade and keep his unbeaten record intact. Gentle Hurricane ran a cracker in the Acomb considering his inexperience and appeals as the type to go on progressing, while promising Ballydoyle colt Sergei Diaghilev is another serious contender commanding plenty of respect. races.display_title: Betfred Park Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict: MORE THUNDER was a shade disappointing in the Prix Jacques le Marois at Deauville last month, but he stands out on the pick of his form now back at Group 2 level. races.display_title: Betfred St Leger Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict: This test is likely to bring out the best in CHRISTMAS DAY given the manner of his gruelling Derby victory and his 2 starts subsequently, so he can provide Aidan O'Brien with a fourth straight win in Britain's oldest Classic. Joseph O'Brien saddles the progressive pair Enceladus and Highwayman , with the former looking the strongest challenger on form, while the selection's stablemate Pierre Bonnard should be on the premises again. CHRISTMAS DAY (IRE) ENCELADUS (IRE) PIERRE BONNARD (IRE)

races.display_title: Pertemps Network Handicap (Str)
races.verdict: No shortage of chances in a cracking handicap but thriving 4-y-o INSPIRED escapes a penalty for last week's York success and can cope with the rise in class and make it 4 wins from his last 5 starts. Britannia scorer Moonfall ran right up to his best when second back at Ascot last time and he's feared. William Haggas pair Bullet Point and Scoville are others to consider, with Blue Courvoisier and Fifth Column completing an exhaustive shortlist. INSPIRED (IRE) MOONFALL (IRE) BULLET POINT

races.display_title: Peterhead Fish Market Handicap
races.verdict: BLACK STORM may be able to follow up his victory in this grade at Catterick last month. Carolus Magnus is likely to have a big say returning to a course where he excels, with Vince Le Prince , Coconut Bay and Masaban others to consider in a competitive handicap. BLACK STORM (IRE) CAROLUS MAGNUS (IRE) VINCE LE PRINCE

races.verdict: ARUNDEL proved he retains all his ability after nearly a year off when third at Yarmouth 13 days ago and a reproduction of that form may well suffice back down in grade. Stintino Sunset and Revich are more consistent than most at this level and they head the opposition. ARUNDEL (IRE) STINTINO SUNSET REVICH (IRE)

races.display_title: Alec Smith Is Getting Married Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict: WHO IS ALICE found things a bit easier taking on her elders for the first time when third over C&D recently and is put forward as the answer from a 2 lb lower mark, especially with a handy 5-lb claimer now taking over in the saddle. Amarachi shaped better than the distance beaten suggests on last month's return at Beverley and must enter calculations in first-time cheekpieces, while Freedom Bay , a C&D winner earlier in the summer, can also figure if casting aside a lesser effort at Lingfield. WHO IS ALICE AMARACHI (IRE) FREEDOM BAY

races.display_title: John Smith's Jump Jockeys Challenge Handicap (Professional Jump Jockeys) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: NIBRAS GOLD won over C&D in a first-time tongue strap in July and, having shaped well at Brighton last time, is fancied to resume winning ways back at this venue. Loki impressed when making a winning handicap debut at Carlisle with a bit in hand and looks too well treated to ignore despite a high draw, so rates the main danger. Spartan Times is also respected. NIBRAS GOLD (IRE) LOKI (GER) SPARTAN TIMES
races.betting_forecast: Loki (3/1), Nibras Gold (7/2), Arrange (9/2), Haveyoumissedme (13/2), Spartan Times (10/1), Sigliosa (10/1), Damascus Steel (12/1), Bravais (16/1), Kuredu King (16/1), Mick Collins (20/1), Kind Of Kiss (50/1)
